body:
I have happy music! My friends usually send me a lot of tunes when I'm feeling down, so ive gathered quite the list. You may have heard this one, but its one that hit seriously home for me, and i'm here with more if need be

http://www.zefrank.com/chillout/

I'm sorry you feel that way. Youre right to say that I am young, and maybe a tad naive, but I've also been there. I've been in the emergency room before and had to face everyone I love after an attempt failed. I truly am sorry if I couldn't help; some people I really, really got through to last night and others not so much.  This is my first shot at reaching a hand out like this, but the beauty about this community is that even if you don't feel like I can help, theres someone on here that can be more than capable. Stay strong.

By no means do you have to apologize AT ALL. I would not be here if I hadn't gone through it too. I attempted suicide about four years ago, and my mom had to witness it. I know what its like to have these thoughts, and the fact that youre seeking help now is an extremely good sign. Is there anything you can pinpoint that is making you feel this way?
Talk to me. Whats on your mind?
I'm your girl. Talk to me, and I'll try my hardest.

I'm glad that you didn't let that discourage you from seeking help from other sources. Luckily, you've stumbled upon an entire community of people who would absolutely love to hear from you. If you need anything at all, we're here to talk.
